user_requirements: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW of a marketing growth blueprint — not an acquisition analysis. DRAFT_BLUEPRINT.md is a 3-page online-growth blueprint for an NZ-based beaded-dress brand positioned as a Clio Peppiatt-adjacent 'dupe' aesthetic play (BRAND_CONTEXT.md holds the verified facts, the owner's goal, and the NZ legal frame — treat it as ground truth; do not re-litigate facts marked verified). Your job is to harden this blueprint before it becomes the final client deliverable. Review on five axes: (1) EFFECTIVENESS — will this actually grow online exposure for a zero/low-audience NZ fashion brand, or is any recommendation generic filler? Flag anything that wouldn't survive contact with the real TikTok/IG/Pinterest fashion ecosystem in 2026, and anything missing that a sharp DTC fashion operator would consider obvious (e.g. SEO, affiliate, livestream, Shopify conversion levers, AU expansion sequencing). (2) LEGAL/PLATFORM SAFETY — does any recommendation create Fair Trading Act 1986, Trade Marks Act 2002, Copyright Act 1994, or Meta/TikTok ad-policy exposure? Is the 'sell the look, never the name' rule applied consistently, including the listicle-pitching tactic (does inducing third parties to publish the comparison create accessory liability or ad-disclosure issues under FTA/ASA codes)? (3) HORMOZI FIDELITY — is the Grand Slam Offer construction, Core Four allocation, Rule of 100, and More/Better/New sequencing faithful and correctly adapted to NZ, or distorted? (4) FEASIBILITY — is the workload realistic for a small owner-operated brand (100 min/day content, 10-20 creator seedings, weekly drops)? Flag over-commitments and give the trimmed version. (5) HONESTY — any claim, stat, or implied promise in the draft that is unverified or unsourceable must be flagged (the final document may not contain uncited third-party stats). Output: numbered findings each with severity (BLOCKING / MAJOR / MINOR), the exact text or section affected, and the exact replacement wording or addition. End with a verdict: GO / CONDITIONAL_GO / NO_GO for shipping this as the final 3-page PDF, listing exactly what must change first. Be strict — this is the only automated gate before delivery.
acquirer_context: Owner is a hands-on NZ multi-business operator who wants dense, practical, no-fluff output. The final deliverable is a strict 3-page PDF, so every finding that ADDS content must also say what to CUT to keep the page budget. The owner's family previously built SOEURS (dupe-positioned perfume brand) whose ETR review established the NZ dupe-marketing legal frame — stay consistent with that precedent. Low legal-risk appetite.
